critical_observations: Independently modeled all eight division situations and verified whether each asks for group size or number of groups.
Checked the open comparison: 30 pencils at 6 per cup gives 5 cups, while 30 pencils in 5 cups gives 6 per cup.
artifact_findings: Exactly eight readable problems are present.
The set meaningfully alternates missing group size and missing group count.
The key uses equations, labels, and complete contextual answers.
rationale: A strong foundational division worksheet with correct quotients and unusually clear attention to the two meanings of division.
